name: Boxer
status_note: Formerly Taskbox; $3M seed led by SHV (its earlier $600K came from angels). Acquired by VMware (AirWatch) in October 2015 per ZDNet.
quote: Boxer, an inbox management app, has landed $3 million seed stage funding led by Sutter Hill Ventures.

name: Curbside
status_note: SHV was new at the $25M Series B; the earlier $9.5M seed and Series A (led by Index Ventures) named no SHV. Acquired by Rakuten (TechCrunch, 2018-06-07).
quote: The round was led by Sutter Hill Ventures, and includes participation from prior investors Index Ventures

name: Infer
status_note: $10M Series A led by Redpoint with SHV participating. Founder Vik Singh was an entrepreneur in residence at SHV (TechCrunch 2013; CNBC 2021), so SHV may have seeded it, but no source names an earlier SHV round. ESW Capital completed the acquisition and folded Infer into Ignite Technologies (GZ Consulting, 2017-11-06). City not found (Silicon Valley).
quote: Infer has raised $10 million in Series A funding led by Redpoint Ventures, with other investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Social+Capital Partnership, Sutter Hill Ventures

name: Rigetti Computing
status_note: Series A ($24M, led by Andreessen Horowitz) and Series B were announced together on 2017-03-28; the Series A closed earlier, date not given. Public on Nasdaq (RGTI) after the Supernova Partners Acquisition Co II SPAC closed 2022-03-02 (Wikipedia). The SPAC's 425 filing also names SHV as an early investor.
quote: Institutional investors in Series A include Sutter Hill Ventures, Susa Ventures, Streamlined Ventures, Lux Capital, and Bloomberg Beta.

name: Transposit
status_note: $12.2M Series A led by SHV; SHV again an existing investor in the $35M Series B led by Altimeter (TechCrunch 2020). A small earlier seed (about $3M, implied by the $50.4M total) has no named investors in sources read. Sam Pullara (SHV) listed as its investor (TechCrunch 2020). transposit.com says the company shut its doors (2024) and Harness licensed the technology.
quote: Sutter Hill Ventures led the Series A round, with participation from SignalFire and Unusual Ventures.

name: Vlocity
status_note: $60M Series C at a $1B valuation, co-led by SHV and Salesforce Ventures; no source shows SHV in the earlier rounds. Salesforce acquired Vlocity for $1.33B in cash (announced 2020-02-25).
quote: The round was led by Sutter Hill Ventures and Salesforce Ventures.

name: PredictHQ
status_note: US$22M Series B led by SHV, which NZ Herald calls its first major investment down under (so SHV was new). Existing investors: Lightspeed, Aspect, Rampersand. Brian Blond (SHV) quoted. Also has a San Francisco office.
quote: PredictHQ announced it has raised $22 million in Series B funding led by Sutter Hill Ventures.

name: DataRobot
status_note: $300M Series G led by Altimeter and Tiger Global; SHV a new investor. Chad Peets (SHV managing director) says it was SHV's first investment at this stage of a company's growth.
quote: joined by new investors Counterpoint Global (Morgan Stanley), Franklin Templeton, ServiceNow Ventures, and Sutter Hill Ventures

name: Astronomer
status_note: $213M Series C led by Insight Partners with SHV participating; no source read shows SHV earlier. Scott Yara of SHV sits on the board (NY Post 2025). Remote-first with hubs in Cincinnati, New York, San Francisco, San Jose; NY office per NY Post.
quote: with participation by Meritech Capital, Salesforce Ventures, J.P. Morgan, K5 Global, Sutter Hill Ventures, Venrock and Sierra Ventures.

name: AttoTude
status_note: $29M Series A with SHV among investors; the lead is not named in sources read. An $11M seed earlier in 2024 has no named investors, so SHV may have entered at the seed. SHV an existing investor in the $50M Series B led by Mayfield (2025-04-01).
quote: Investors include Sutter Hill Ventures, Canaan Partners, and Wing Venture Capital.

name: Integrated Biosciences
status_note: $17.2M seed led by SHV; Keith Loebner (SHV) named to the board. A 2026 Form D (first sale 2026-07-21, $68.4M sold of $100M) lists Loebner as director, so a larger 2026 round exists.
quote: today announced that it has closed a $17.2 million seed financing, led by Sutter Hill Ventures

name: DVx
status_note: DVx Ventures (Jon McNeill's venture studio) raised about $100M for its company-creation platform. The Axios article (2024-11-18) that matched the SHV query returned HTTP 403; a search snippet of it says McNeill cites Sutter Hill as a model for its evergreen structure, not as an investor. McNeill's own announcement names no SHV. Even an SHV stake would be in a fund-like studio (D6). Worth a look if Axios becomes readable.

name: io Products
status_note: SHV's investment was confirmed by Bloomberg (per TechCrunch) after Luke Wroblewski (SHV) deleted a post; SHV possibly the second-largest investor. No source names the round. Wikipedia says io raised $225M in 2024 from SHV, Emerson Collective, SV Angel, Maverick and Thrive. Acquired by OpenAI in a $6.5B all-stock deal (May 2025).
quote: Despite the deleted tweets, Bloomberg also confirmed Sutter Hill Ventures was an investor.

name: Aven
status_note: The $110M Series E ($2.2B valuation) was led by Khosla with General Catalyst, GIC, Founders Fund and others; the Series D release lists Khosla, General Catalyst, Caffeinated, Electric, Founders Fund, The General Partnership. No SHV in any list. The Axios Pro Rata newsletter that matched the SHV query (2025-09-09) almost certainly named SHV for Ridge Biotechnologies' SHV-led seed announced that day.
quote: The round was led by Khosla Ventures; General Catalyst, GIC, Founders Fund and others were also involved.

name: Ridge Biotechnologies
status_note: Incubated by SHV (founder Kightlinger was an SHV entrepreneur in residence); $25M seed led by SHV, emerging from stealth 2025-09-09. The seed was extended to $38M on 2026-09-09.
quote: The funding round was led by Sutter Hill Ventures (SHV), which incubated Ridge Bio

name: Ramp
status_note: $500M Series E-2 at $22.5B led by ICONIQ; SHV listed among new investors. SHV an existing investor in the $300M round at $32B (2025-11-17).
quote: New investors for this round include: Sutter Hill Ventures, Lightspeed Ventures, T. Rowe Price Associates, Inc., GV (Google Ventures)

name: Glydways
status_note: $170M Series C co-led by Suzuki, ACS Group and Khosla; existing Mitsui Chemicals and Gates Frontier, new Obayashi. No SHV. The Axios newsletter (2026-04-14) that matched the SHV query covers several deals; nEye.ai's SHV-led Series C was announced the same day.
quote: The round was co-led by Suzuki Motor Corporation, ACS Group, and Khosla Ventures.

name: Fathom Therapeutics
status_note: Formerly Atommap Corp. $47M Series A led by SHV; Keith Loebner (SHV) quoted and listed as director on the 2026 Form D (first sale 2026-03-06). The 2023 seed Form D ($7.1M) lists only the CEO, so SHV entered at the Series A.
quote: Sutter Hill Ventures led the round, with participation from Chemistry, Alexandria Venture Investments, and Empire State Development's NY Ventures

name: GridCARE
status_note: $64M Series A led by SHV (Vic Miller, SHV managing director, quoted). The $13.5M seed (2025) was led by Xora with no SHV. Described as California-based and Stanford-founded; city not confirmed (citybiz files it under San Francisco).
quote: Sutter Hill Ventures led the investment, which included participation from John Doerr, National Grid Partners, and Future Energy Ventures

name: Stitch
status_note: Saudi fintech; $25M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz (its first Gulf deal). No source names SHV. The Axios newsletter (2026-05-14) that matched the SHV query also covered GridCARE's SHV-led Series A that day. Other participants not listed in sources read.
quote: Alex Rampell, general partner at Andreessen Horowitz, which led the funding round

name: DayOne
status_note: DayOne Data Centers' $4.5B Series C was led by existing investors Coatue and Hillhouse, with new investors Indonesia Investment Authority and Achi Capital. No SHV. Same Axios newsletter as Stitch (GridCARE explains the SHV match). Reported confidential US IPO filing (2026-08).
quote: The Series C round was led by existing investors Coatue and Hillhouse, now DayOne's two largest shareholders

name: Ineffable Intelligence
status_note: David Silver's $1.1B seed was led by Sequoia and Lightspeed; UKTN lists the full syndicate (British Business Bank, Sovereign AI, Sequoia, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Index, Google, EQT, Evantic, Flying Fish, DST, BOND). No SHV. The Axios newsletter (2026-04-27) matched because Fathom's SHV-led Series A was announced that day.
quote: include Sequioa, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Index, Google, EQT, Evantic, Flying Fish, DST Global and BOND.

name: Wavefront
status_note: Co-founded by SHV managing director Sam Pullara (CNBC 2021), so an incubation. SHV was an existing investor at the $52M Series B (2016-10-25), so it entered at the Series A or before; that round's date is not in sources read. Sold to VMware in 2017 (CNBC).
quote: Existing investors Sequoia Capital and Sutter Hill Ventures were joined by new investor Tenaya Capital, and other equity holders.

name: FoundationDB
status_note: $17M Series A led by SHV after an angel-funded seed. Acquired by Apple (reported 2015-03-24).
quote: The Series A round was led by Sutter Hill Ventures with additional investment from CrunchFund

name: Menlo Security
status_note: $25M Series B led by new investor SHV at stealth exit (General Catalyst, Osage, Engineering Capital were earlier). SHV an existing investor in the 2017 Series C and 2019 Series D.
quote: As for that $25 million in Series B funding, the round was led by new investor Sutter Hill Ventures.

name: Bracket Computing
status_note: Emerged from stealth in October 2014 disclosing $85M in combined Series A and B; SHV among the backers of that earlier funding and again in the $46.4M October 2015 round. VMware agreed to acquire its intellectual property and key staff (VMware blog, 2018-05-01).
quote: Andreessen Horowitz, Sutter Hill, Artis and Allegis also supported the earlier funding

name: Instart Logic
status_note: Earliest round naming SHV is the $17M Series B (headline credits Andreessen Horowitz and Greylock); investors of the $9M 2012 Series A are not named in sources read. SHV a prior investor in the 2014 Series C led by KPCB. Akamai acquired its customers and select IP (2020-02-27, Wikipedia). Later renamed Instart.
quote: has raised $17 million in Series B funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Greylock Partners, Sutter Hill Ventures and Tenaya Capital.

name: ThousandEyes
status_note: $20M Series B led by SHV; Stefan Dyckerhoff (SHV) joined the board. The 2013 $5.5M Series A came from Sequoia only. Cisco acquired ThousandEyes (reported 2020-05-29, about $1B).
quote: Sutter Hill Ventures led the round, which also included Salesforce Ventures, existing investor Sequoia Capital and Silicon Valley angels.

name: OpenDNS
status_note: Undisclosed Series B from SHV alone; Stefan Dyckerhoff (SHV) joined the board. SHV a previous backer in the 2014 Series C. Cisco acquired OpenDNS for $635M (2015). Also on SHV's own April 2013 portfolio page.
quote: raising an undisclosed amount of Series B funding from Sutter Hill Ventures.

name: Viz.ai
status_note: The $2.5M seed (matching the 2016-09 Form D) came from Innovation Endeavors and AME Cloud Ventures. The Form D person at 755 Page Mill Rd is Michael O'Donnell of Morrison & Foerster, whose Palo Alto office shares SHV's street address (SEC S-3 cover page), so the address match is a false positive.
quote: Eric Schmidt's investment firm, Innovation Endeavors, and Yahoo founder Jerry Yang's AME Ventures

name: Eversight
status_note: SHV led a $14.5M round (series not named; Form D first sale 2016-03-31) joined by previous investor Emergence Capital, so SHV was new. Jim White (SHV) quoted and on the Form D. Acquired by Instacart (2022-09-01).
quote: Sutter Hill Ventures led the round, and was joined by previous investor Emergence Capital.

name: Tomfoolery
status_note: $1.7M seed announced January 2013. Business Insider names the firm; TechCrunch names 'Sam Pullara at Sutter Hill Ventures'; SHV's own April 2013 portfolio page lists Tomfoolery, which supports a firm position rather than a personal check. Acquired by Yahoo (January 2014). City not found.
quote: has raised $1.7 million from Morado Ventures, Sutter Hill Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, AME Cloud Ventures

name: Talent Zoo
status_note: Not a portfolio company. Talent Zoo is a card game SHV made for friends and family and sold through its own store (search result for shv.com/talent-zoo; the local CDX lists a 2021-12-25 capture of that page). The live page is now 404 and the Wayback copy was unreadable during the machine-wide IA cooldown; verify the capture after the cooldown.

name: Glean
status_note: The Series F lists new and existing investors (Wellington lead; Khosla, Altimeter, Coatue, DST, General Catalyst, ICONIQ, IVP, Kleiner, Lightspeed, Sapphire, Sequoia and others). No SHV.
quote: Others in the Series F include Khosla Ventures, Bicycle Capital, Geodesic Capital, and Archerman Capital, as well as existing investors Altimeter

name: Cyera
status_note: The Series G was led by Evolution Equity with Accel, AT&T Ventures, Blackstone, Coatue, Spark and others; Wikipedia names early investors Sequoia and Cyberstarts. No SHV anywhere read.
quote: Evolution Equity Partners led the $600 million Series G round with participation from Accel, AT&T Ventures, Blackstone, Coatue, Spark Capital and others.

name: Lucira Health
status_note: The IPO prospectus's 5% holders are EPIQ, Eclipse and Seraph; SEC full-text search finds no 'Sutter Hill Ventures' in any Lucira filing. Pfizer bought its assets in a 2023 bankruptcy auction and later shut the business.
quote: 5% or Greater Stockholders: Entities affiliated with EPIQ Capital Group, LLC

name: Ceribell
status_note: The IPO prospectus's 5% holders are ABG WTT, Longitude, The Rise Fund, Red Tree, Optimas and u.life. Its only 'Sutter' is Sutter Health (a study site), the likely source of the aggregator's match. Nasdaq CBLL since the October 2024 IPO.
quote: Sutter Health N: 100 No adverse events related to Ceribell System reported

name: Clari
status_note: The $225M 2022 round was led by Blackstone with Silver Lake, Bain Capital Ventures, Madrona, Sapphire and Sequoia; no SHV in any round coverage read. Merged with Salesloft (agreement 2025-08-07, per headline); the combined company now brands as Salesloft.
quote: Bain Capital Ventures, Madrona Ventures, Sapphire Ventures and Sequoia Capital were among the more than half-dozen firms that participated

name: Observe
status_note: Incubated at SHV (TechCrunch 2026); emerged from stealth with $35M led by SHV (earlier Form Ds not seen). Mike Speiser (SHV) director. Snowflake announced the acquisition 2026-01-08; completed by early February 2026 per later headlines.
quote: Observe Inc Emerges From Stealth Raises $35M In Funding Led By Sutter Hill Ventures

name: Lacework
status_note: SHV incubation (Stefan Dyckerhoff original CEO; co-founder Vikram Kapoor an SHV EIR from 2014). SHV co-led the $525M Series D with Altimeter (2021-01-07). First round not named in sources read. Acquired by Fortinet (2024).
quote: Speiser has shifted his attention to another project Sutter Hill incubated. It's a security company called Lacework

name: Clumio
status_note: Speiser (SHV) director on its first Form D (2017-11-17, $10.4M). TechCrunch lists SHV among investors. Acquired by Commvault (2024-09-24). City is model knowledge (2017 Form D gave San Jose).
quote: The firm raised $261 million in venture capital from investors including Index Ventures, NewView Capital, and Sutter Hill Ventures

name: Ghost Autonomy
status_note: Formerly Ghost Locomotion (founded 2017). Speiser (SHV) director on every Form D from 2018. TechCrunch credits 'Speiser at Sutter Hill Ventures' among early investors. Shut down April 2024.
quote: $63.7 million in total investment from Rabois of Founders Fund, Vinod Khosla at Khosla Ventures and Speiser at Sutter Hill Ventures

name: Astera Labs
status_note: SHV a previous investor at the 2021 Series C (led by Fidelity); Dyckerhoff (SHV) on the board. Entry round not named in sources read. IPO March 2024 (Nasdaq ALAB).
quote: previous investors Avigdor Willenz Group, GlobalLink1 Capital, Intel Capital, Sutter Hill Ventures and VentureTech Alliance also participating

name: Enfabrica
status_note: SHV participated in the $125M Series B led by Atreides (2023); AlleyWatch lists SHV as backer of the pre-Series B funding. The Series A lead is not confirmed in sources read. Status after the November 2024 $115M round not checked.
quote: Led by Atreides Management with participation from Sutter Hill Ventures, Nvidia, IAG Capital Partners

name: Luminary Cloud
status_note: Incubation: the first Form D (2020-12-11, $15M) gives the issuer address as 755 Page Mill Road, with co-founders Jason Lango and Juan Alonso plus Speiser at SHV's Suite A-200. SHV led the $115M disclosed at stealth exit (2024-03-13).
quote: Backed by Sutter Hill Ventures, which led its $115 million funding

name: Augment Code
status_note: Augment Computing, Inc.: the Series A Form D (first sale 2023-09-28, $25M) lists the issuer at SHV's Suite A-200 with Speiser as executive officer (incubation). $25M Series A led by SHV; $227M Series B (2024-04-24).
quote: following its $25 million Series A led by Sutter Hill Ventures

name: Celero Communications
status_note: Series A led by SHV (disclosed with a CapitalG-led Series B, $140M together). City from Orange County Business Journal coverage, not a stated HQ. $275M Series C at $3B+ (2026-09-08).
quote: a Series A round led by Sutter Hill Ventures LP with participation from Valor Equity Partners LP, Atreides Management LP and Maverick Silicon

name: nEye.ai
status_note: nEye Systems; $80M Series C led by SHV with existing investors CapitalG, M12, Socratic, so SHV was new. Stefan Dyckerhoff (SHV) linked in coverage.
quote: Santa Clara-based nEye.ai raised $80 million in Series C led by Sutter Hill Ventures, with CapitalG, M12, and Socratic Partners

name: Aria Networks
status_note: Founded 2025; its Form D (first sale 2026-04-06, $73M sold of $100M) gives the issuer address as 755 Page Mill Road Suite A-200 with Dyckerhoff (SHV) director, so an SHV incubation. $125M Series A; lead not stated in sources read.
quote: Founded in 2025, Aria Networks is backed by Sutter Hill Ventures, Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and Eclipse Ventures.

name: Atmosic Technologies
status_note: NEW: not in the parametric list or the Form D sweeps. Launched with $21M from investors including SHV, Clear Ventures and Walden (round name and lead not given). SHV still listed as a backer at the $40M round (March 2025).
quote: The startup has raised $21 million from investors that include Sutter Hill Ventures, Clear Ventures, and Walden International

name: Matic Robots
status_note: NEW: robot-vacuum maker. $50M Series A 'from Sutter Hill Ventures' with Valor, Atreides and others participating, valued at $650M per a source. Earlier backers were angels (Collisons, Garry Tan, Adam D'Angelo). Lead inferred from the wording.
quote: The company just announced a new $50 million fundraise, its Series A, from Sutter Hill Ventures

name: Sila Nanotechnologies
status_note: Already an SHV company before 2016; listed here because SHV led the $375M Series G in 2024 as an existing investor.
quote: Sila, a battery materials company, secured $375 million in a Series G funding round led by Sutter Hill Ventures, an existing investor

name: Sigma Computing
status_note: Founded 2014 by Jason Frantz and Rob Woollen while SHV entrepreneurs in residence (Bitmoon Computing, Form D 2014 with Speiser as director). SHV an existing investor in later rounds (Series C 2021, Series D 2024).
quote: which Frantz and Woollen founded while entrepreneurs in residence at Sutter Hill Ventures

name: Forty Seven
status_note: $75M Series A co-led by Lightspeed and SHV; Jeff Bird (SHV) quoted. Gilead acquisition (2020) is not re-verified here.
quote: The Series A financing was led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Sutter Hill Ventures with participation from Clarus Ventures and GV

name: GRAIL
status_note: Formed by Illumina; over $100M Series A from Illumina and ARCH, with Bezos Expeditions, Bill Gates and SHV participating. Now public (GRAL) after the 2024 spin-off from Illumina.
quote: with participating investments from Bezos Expeditions, Bill Gates and Sutter Hill Ventures

name: Lifesize (2016 spin-off)
status_note: NEW position: $17.5M from Redpoint, SHV and Meritech when Lifesize split from Logitech (2016). Same brand as the 2000s SHV company LifeSize Communications (sold to Logitech 2009); decide whether this is one row or two. Filed for bankruptcy 2023, assets to Enghouse Systems (headline).
quote: Redpoint Ventures, Sutter Hill Ventures and Meritech Capital Partners have put in funds into the company

name: GLMX
status_note: Out of window (co-founded April 2010 with SHV as partner); already on SHV's April 2013 portfolio page. Money-market trading platform, active in 2026.
quote: He started by partnering with one of the venture capital world's most successful and experienced firms, Sutter Hill Ventures

name: Nutcracker Therapeutics
status_note: The Series B (2020, led by ARCH) included Bluebird Ventures, which the release calls a firm associated with SHV. Bluebird Ventures I, L.P. is Jeff Bird's own vehicle and external under D1, so not an SHV position.
quote: including Bluebird Ventures, a firm associated with Sutter Hill Ventures

name: Lensing (fka Everest Systems)
status_note: AI-native ERP; the idea started in 2020 when co-founder Sandeep Chopra was an SHV entrepreneur in residence. No source read names SHV money (investor logos on lensing.ai are unlabeled; Bessemer is an investor). No Form D found under either name.
quote: Sandeep Chopra, a seasoned product leader who was entrepreneur-in-residence at Sutter Hill Ventures in Palo Alto

name: Monaco
status_note: The only SHV link is a person: co-founder Brian Blond was formerly at SHV. Seed and Series A were led by Founders Fund with Human Capital.
quote: Brian is a partner at Human Capital and was formerly at Sutter Hill.

name: Primal Therapies
status_note: An address-sweep false positive (2016 Form D). Its 755 Page Mill Rd person is Michael O'Donnell of Morrison & Foerster, whose Palo Alto office is at 755 Page Mill Road (no suite); SHV is Suite A-200. Same cause as Viz.ai.
